h: People re-key data between tools that do not talk to each other.
what: I connect the systems and make the handoff a job with retries and an audit trail.
link: AI agents working inside a live ERP

h: We want AI, but our data lives in an ERP or a scheduling system.
what: I build the AI layer on top of the system of record, not a second copy of it.
link: An AI voice front desk for dental clinics

h: The AI demo works. Production does not.
what: I find what breaks between the demo and real traffic, and fix it at the root.

h: Signals arrive from everywhere and nobody sees the important ones.
what: I build ingestion, search and alerting that says why it fired.
link: A social and market signal intelligence backend

h: The system runs, and nobody trusts what it shows.
what: I trace the numbers back to their source until they add up.
link: An operations console for a healthcare integration engine
